diffuseAlbedo.note: A first colour for Black lacquer (黑漆): no measured colour was read: a first value read from trade and museum photographs of the named material.

refractiveIndex.source: Wikipedia, 'Tung oil', infobox: refractive index 1.52 (20 C), https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tung_oil
refractiveIndex.note: This is the liquid tung oil's index, a proxy. It holds for a tung-oil (光油) black finish; for a urushiol lacquer, the film's index was not found and not verified. A polymerised film is likely somewhat higher. Hou et al. 2025 (Polymers 17(11):1481, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12157858) confirm a closed, glossy Chinese lacquer film (88.96 to 90.96 GU at 60 deg; Ra 0.122 to 0.138 um) but give no index.

porosity.note: A cured lacquer film is closed.

wettingDepth.note: The depth whose pores govern the face's look when wet.

grain.note: The finest structure the face shows.

bed.note: The coarsest structure the face shows.

hurst.source: Candela et al. 2012, Journal of Geophysical Research 117, B08409 (fault surfaces, 0.6 to 0.8; cited in Stone.ush)
hurst.note: The middle of the range measured on rock surfaces, as the travertine's.

toneSpread.note: A first half-range of ln(albedo) across one face.

roughnessSpread.note: A first half-range of ln(roughness) across one face.
